Post 1
📈 Tech led the charge as the ASX 200 added 54.10 pts (+0.60%) to close at 9,092.30 — just 2.20% from its 52-week high. The session's tension: property bled while growth names surged. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
IT ran +2.31%, the clear session winner. Materials added +0.98% on metals strength. The lone loser worth noting: A-REITs dropped 0.78% — rate sensitivity biting while growth sectors thrived. #ASX #property #tech

Post 3
🔻 PEXA GROUP crashed 17.43% to AUD 6.68 — the session's sharpest single-stock move by a wide margin. While the index climbed, PXA reminded markets that not every boat rises. #ASX #ausbiz #fintech

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,406.44/oz underpinned the Materials rally. Silver hit AUD 98.43/oz. With the AUD/USD at 0.7190, local gold miners are capturing strong margins. #gold #silver #mining #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits 2.20% off its 52-week high. One question for the week: can IT hold its +2.31% lead, or does rate pressure drag it back? What's your call — new highs by Friday? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
